local tab="trade"
local pg=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local res=tostring(workspace:GetAttribute("DevResult"))
local opened=string.find(res,"Tab:"..tab.." true",1,true)~=nil
local vp=workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
local function shown(d) local x=d while x and x~=pg do if x:IsA("GuiObject") and not x.Visible then return false end if x:IsA("LayerCollector") and not x.Enabled then return false end x=x.Parent end return x==pg end
local off,small,clip,btns={},0,0,0
for _,g in pg:GetChildren() do
 if g:IsA("ScreenGui") and g.Enabled then
  for _,d in g:GetDescendants() do
   if d:IsA("GuiButton") and d.AbsoluteSize.X>1 and shown(d) then
    local sf=d:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScrollingFrame")
    local p,s=d.AbsolutePosition,d.AbsoluteSize
    btns+=1
    if not sf and (p.X<-2 or p.Y<-2 or p.X+s.X>vp.X+2 or p.Y+s.Y>vp.Y+2) and #off<4 then table.insert(off,(d.Name~="" and d.Name or d.ClassName).."@"..math.floor(p.X)..","..math.floor(p.Y)) end
    if math.min(s.X,s.Y)<36 then small+=1 end
   end
   if (d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton")) and d.Text~="" and not d.TextScaled and d.AbsoluteSize.X>1 and shown(d) and not d.TextFits then clip+=1 end
  end
 end
end
workspace:SetAttribute("QAMenuAudit",(workspace:GetAttribute("QAMenuAudit") or "")..string.format("|%s:%s:off%d:small%d:clip%d",tab,opened and "open" or "NOT_OPEN",#off,small,clip))
return string.format("MENU_AUDIT tab=%s opened=%s buttons=%d offscreen=%d[%s] small<36=%d clippedText=%d vp=%dx%d",tab,tostring(opened),btns,#off,table.concat(off,";"),small,clip,vp.X,vp.Y)

local off,small,clip,btns={},0,0,0
for _,g in pg:GetChildren() do
 if g:IsA("ScreenGui") and g.Enabled then
  for _,d in g:GetDescendants() do
   if d:IsA("GuiButton") and d.AbsoluteSize.X>1 and shown(d) then

    if math.min(s.X,s.Y)<36 then small+=1 end
   end
   if (d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton")) and d.Text~="" and not d.TextScaled and d.AbsoluteSize.X>1 and shown(d) and not d.TextFits then clip+=1 end
  end
 end
end

-- [도크 실클릭 준비] 열린 시설 책을 기존 X 버튼으로 닫아야 아래 도크가 보인다.
local gui=assert(game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("MareEssentiaGui"))
local btn=assert(gui:FindFirstChild("CloseX",true),"MENU_BOOK_CLOSE_MISSING")
assert(btn.Visible and btn.Active,"MENU_BOOK_CLOSE_DISABLED")
return string.format("%d,%d CLICK=시설닫기",math.floor(btn.AbsolutePosition.X+btn.AbsoluteSize.X/2),math.floor(btn.AbsolutePosition.Y+btn.AbsoluteSize.Y/2))

local pg=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local function shown(d) local x=d while x and x~=pg do if x:IsA("GuiObject") and not x.Visible then return false end if x:IsA("LayerCollector") and not x.Enabled then return false end x=x.Parent end return x==pg end
local pick
for _,d in pg:GetDescendants() do
 if d:IsA("GuiButton") and d:GetAttribute("SelectedFacility")==false and shown(d) and d.AbsoluteSize.X>1 then pick=d break end
end
assert(pick,"MENU_DOCK_NO_UNSELECTED_BUTTON")
pick:SetAttribute("QADockTarget",true)
return string.format("%d,%d CLICK=dock_%s",math.floor(pick.AbsolutePosition.X+pick.AbsoluteSize.X/2),math.floor(pick.AbsolutePosition.Y+pick.AbsoluteSize.Y/2),pick.Name)

local pg=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local t
for _,d in pg:GetDescendants() do if d:IsA("GuiButton") and d:GetAttribute("QADockTarget") then t=d end end
assert(t,"MENU_DOCK_TARGET_LOST")
t:SetAttribute("QADockTarget",nil)
-- [실제 클릭 결과] 누른 시설 버튼이 선택 상태가 되어야 실제 메뉴 이동으로 인정한다.
assert(t:GetAttribute("SelectedFacility")==true,"MENU_DOCK_CLICK_NO_CHANGE:"..t.Name)
return "MENU_DOCK_CLICK_PASS "..t.Name

local a=tostring(workspace:GetAttribute("QAMenuAudit"))
local notOpen,offBad={},{}
for tab,state,off in string.gmatch(a,"|([%w_]+):([%w_]+):off(%d+)") do
 if state~="open" then table.insert(notOpen,tab) end
 if tonumber(off)>0 then table.insert(offBad,tab..":"..off) end
end
-- [메뉴 결함 판정] 열리지 않은 메뉴, 화면 밖으로 나간 버튼이 있으면 실패. 작은 터치·잘린 글자는 수치로 보고.
assert(#notOpen==0,"MENU_NOT_OPENED:"..table.concat(notOpen,","))
assert(#offBad==0,"MENU_BUTTON_OFFSCREEN:"..table.concat(offBad,","))
return "MENU_AUDIT_SUMMARY "..a
